sections.note: Single 1280x528 zone holding raw text 'Affiliate Dashboard app_id="58...' -> an embedded live-app demo widget, not authored copy

proposed_rules.trigger: A template/app-demo page's main content zone renders as an app_id="..." attribute string instead of visible UI, indicating the embedded live Knack app iframe did not render (cross-origin/lazy-load) during capture.
proposed_rules.decision: Do not treat the leaked attribute text as page copy. Flag the zone as an 'app-demo-embed' placeholder block and route to Phase 2 targeted capture/screenshot rather than importing the raw string. Alternatives considered: treat literally as default-content text (rejected - it's a source/DOM leak, not authored content); treat as noise and drop entirely (rejected - the embed itself is real, reusable page content, just under-rendered).
proposed_rules.rationale: Compare to cluster C64 (same page-18/page-4 template pair) where the equivalent zone DID render full app UI (dashboard table) - confirming this is a capture inconsistency, not a real content difference between pages.

provenance.evidence: C63 rc1c2 'Affiliate Dashboard app_id="58...' vs C64 rc1c2c1 fully-rendered dashboard/table

notes: Sparsest page in the batch; the entire body is an under-rendered app embed. Needs Phase 2 re-capture before authoring.
